title: kobresia rufa
intro: Kobresia rufa, commonly known as Dwarf Hairgrass, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Kobresia rufa include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Kobresia rufa include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
